recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-26622 unless a later work-group decision changes Procedure.report or its search semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-26622 was Published/Persuasive for R5. It asked for a Procedure search parameter to support DiagnosticReport reverse-includes; comments clarified the intended element was Procedure.report, not a nonexistent Procedure.result, and the resolution was to add the report search parameter to Procedure.
initial_application: The issue was applied by d1143eeaccb98cee03eaefdc166cfb4216efaa52, whose message explicitly says J#26622 Procedure report search parameter added and whose patch added the report/reference/Procedure.report search row to source/procedure/procedure-spreadsheet.xml. The later source rework commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 introduced source/procedure/bundle-Procedure-search-params.xml with Procedure-report preserved.
additional_context: Procedure is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. The current Procedure source has both the Procedure.report element and the Procedure-report SearchParameter with code report, type reference, and expression Procedure.report. Patient Care Confluence references only showed meeting pages that mention the Jira key, and quoted Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the authoritative current Procedure search-parameter bundle already contains the requested report search parameter.

related_jiras.note: The historical application commit d1143ee also added Procedure.supportingInfo for FHIR-29114, but this reconciliation only decides the FHIR-26622 report search parameter request.
